# Design N Print — Commercial Offset Printing & Packaging Press

> Established in 2008 in Naroda GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Specializing in high-precision commercial offset printing, pharmaceutical cartons, luxury rigid gift packaging, corporate catalogues, and custom foil branding.

## Business Profile & Verification
- **Company Name:** Design N Print
- **Operational Since:** 2008 (16+ years of active printing operations)
- **Primary Facility:** Phase 1, GIDC Industrial Estate, Naroda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382330, India
- **Coordinates:** 23.0827° N, 72.6599° E
- **Direct Owner Hotline:** +91 97252 81074
- **Email:** info@designnprint.in
- **Operating Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST
- **Turnaround Speed:** 24–48 hours express offset plate-to-pack dispatch available across Gujarat GIDC industrial belts.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Pharmaceutical & Medical Packaging
- Custom tablet, capsule, syrup, and injection mono cartons.
- Compliant with strict pharma labeling guidelines, barcode clarity, and tamper-evident reverse-tuck designs.
- Food & Drug grade boards: 250 GSM to 400 GSM Cyber XL and ITC folding box board (FBB).

### 2. Luxury Rigid Boxes & Monocartons
- 2-piece lift-off lid boxes, magnetic closure boxes, slide drawer boxes, and folding monocartons.
- Heavyweight 1.5mm to 3.0mm European greyboard wrapped in customized 150 GSM art paper or textured metallic sheets.
- Ideal for cosmetics, electronics, perfumery, jewelry, and corporate festive gifts.

### 3. Corporate Catalogues, Brochures & Marketing
- Hardcover and softcover multi-page catalogues with PUR / perfect binding, saddle stitching, or wire-o-wire.
- Architectural mica laminates sample books, ceramic tile display folders, and real estate presentation brochures.

### 4. Special Finishes & Surface Embellishments
- Thermal Velvet Lamination (ultra-soft tactile touch)
- Registered Spot UV Coating (high-gloss raised tactile depth)
- Hydraulic Gold & Silver Foil Stamping (reflective metallic sheen)
- Micro-Embossing and Blind Debossing
- Transparent PVC / PET Window Patching

### 5. Ceramic Display Folders & Laminate Mica Folders
- Heavy-duty display folders engineered for Morbi and Gujarat ceramic tile sample collections.
- High-tensile PVC lamination and reinforced hinges to support heavy tile and mica samples.

## Materials & GSM Specifications
- **Lightweight Commercial:** 80–130 GSM Maplitho & Art Paper (Flyers, Booklets, Letterheads)
- **Standard Promotional:** 170–250 GSM Gloss/Matte Art Paper (Brochures, Catalog covers)
- **Heavyweight Packaging:** 300–450 GSM Art Card & Cyber XL (Boxes, Cards, Folders)
- **Rigid Greyboard:** 500–600+ GSM (1.5mm to 3.0mm Kappa/Rigid Board)

## Primary Service Areas
- Ahmedabad (Naroda GIDC, Odhav, Vatva, Kathwada, Changodar, Sanand, S.G. Highway)
- Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Morbi, and pan-Gujarat industrial hubs.
- Nationwide courier dispatch across India.
